snippet.title: PS3 Longplay | DeadStorm Pirates (2010)[1 of 5] PS Move Light Gun Madness
snippet.description:
Game footage split into five parts , one per level since Namco ... what can you tell me more about this game ... well its a port from Arcades so expect sucker punches you can't doge just to get from you more money ... its well 40-ish min long , has 5 levels ... you will waste 2h till you get enough credits to finish this game , since its like to cheat ... and only adds one more credit if you get a Game Over screen ...

Overall it was fun ... would never play again ... kind of game ... next stop the last 4 games ... from this Time Crisis Razing Storm Light Gun bundle ... the next one forces on you to use the "PlayStation Move Sharp Shooter" ... so you know it will be extra fun in the wrong way ... haha
